title: Adult Mouse Lung Cell Dissociation Protocol
author: Andrew Potter

steps.title: Prepare lung tissue on ice
steps.instruction: Optionally perfuse the adult mouse lung with DPBS, then place the lung in ice‑cold DPBS and keep on ice during transport.

steps.title: Mince tissue to fine paste
steps.instruction: Using sterile forceps, transfer the lung to a petri dish on ice, remove excess DPBS with a pipette, and mince the tissue on ice for 2 min until a fine paste is obtained, employing forceps in one hand and a grinding motion with a sterile razor blade in the other.

steps.title: Weigh tissue and add enzyme mix
steps.instruction: Weigh 25 mg of the minced tissue onto the petri dish, place it into 1 mL of the collagenase/elastase/dispase enzyme mix in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, and keep the tube on ice.

steps.title: Incubate with shaking and initial trituration
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on ice, shaking vigorously every 30 seconds. Begin trituration at 2 min and perform 10 triturations every 1.5 min (first with the pipette tip cut).

substeps.instruction: Start trituration at 2 minutes of incubation.
Perform 10 triturations every 1.5 minutes, using a cut tip for the first set.

steps.title: Transfer digest and further mince
steps.instruction: After 5 minutes of digestion, pipette the tissue‑enzyme mixture into a new sterile petri dish on ice and mince for an additional 2 minutes with a razor blade to break residual chunks.

steps.title: Rinse dish and combine with enzyme
steps.instruction: Pipette the digest back into the original 1.5 mL tube, rinse the petri dish with 0.5 mL of fresh collagenase/elastase/dispase enzyme mix, and add the rinse to the same tube.

steps.title: Continue trituration to 9‑min total
steps.instruction: Continue triturating and shaking on ice for 2 additional minutes, reaching a total digestion time of 9 minutes.

steps.title: Settle and filter supernatant
steps.instruction: Let the tube settle for 1 minute on ice; tissue chunks will pellet while released cells remain in the supernatant. Pipette 80 % of the supernatant onto a 30 µm filter placed in a sterile 15 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Rinse filter with PBS/BSA
steps.instruction: Rinse the filter with 6 mL ice‑cold PBS containing 0.04 % BSA, leaving the filter in the 15 mL conical for subsequent steps.

steps.title: Add second enzyme aliquot
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 10 mg/mL B. lich enzyme mix to the residual tissue clumps remaining in the 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Extended trituration and shaking
steps.instruction: Triturate on ice 10 times every 1.5 minutes for an additional 10 minutes (total 20 minutes digestion) while shaking the tube every 30 seconds.

substeps.instruction: Triturate 10 times every 1.5 minutes for 10 minutes.
Shake the tube vigorously every 30 seconds during this period.

steps.title: Final filtration and rinse
steps.instruction: Pipette the entire volume onto the same 30 µm filter in the 15 mL conical and rinse the filter with another 6 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA.

steps.title: Low‑speed spin and supernatant removal
steps.instruction: Spin the filter collection tube at 300 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C. Carefully remove all but 100 µL of supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: RBC lysis and incubation
steps.instruction: Add 900 µL of RBC lysis buffer to the pellet, triturate 20 times using a 1 mL pipette set to 700 µL, and incubate on ice for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Dilute lysis buffer with PBS/BSA
steps.instruction: Add 12 mL ice‑cold PBS containing 0.04 % BSA to the 15 mL conical to dilute the RBC lysis buffer.

steps.title: Second spin to pellet cells
steps.instruction: Spin the tube at 200 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C (low‑g spin) to pellet cells while leaving small debris and platelets in the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in PBS/BSA
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 200 µL ice‑cold PBS containing 0.04 % BSA.

steps.title: Optional dead cell removal
steps.instruction: If desired, perform dead‑cell removal using the EasySep Dead Cell Removal Kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Count cells and adjust concentration
steps.instruction: Examine cells with a hemocytometer using trypan blue, then adjust the suspension to 1,000 cells/µL for 10X Chromium or 100 cells/µL for Drop‑Seq.
